summary: Comprehensive backend + partial frontend e2e testing of IndieForge 3D. 27/27 backend pytest tests passed (100%) covering health, auth (register/login/logout/me), categories, assets list+filters (category/search/engine/format/price/sort), trending, asset detail w/ reviews, featured creators, creator detail w/ portfolio, favorites toggle + listing, my/purchases (auth+unauth), Stripe asset+subscription checkout (pro/studio/free), checkout status, object-storage image upload + retrieval, asset creation + my/analytics chart, commissions create+list. Frontend home page loads with 3D hero scene (Three.js canvas rendering models: cone, capsule, lightsaber, head), categories grid (10 cats), trending asset cards (8 cards), nav, stats. No console errors on home. Search input is present and visible but lacks data-testid='nav-search' attribute, which blocks programmatic search-redirect testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='nav-search' attribute on the search <input>; spec lists it as a required testid. Search input visually present and likely functional, but cannot be programmatically targeted.

action_items: Add data-testid='nav-search' to the Navbar search <input> in frontend (likely src/components/Navbar.jsx) so the spec-defined selector matches.

Once added, re-run the full frontend flow (search→marketplace→asset detail viewer/wireframe/lighting/tabs, login, dashboards, pricing checkout, creator upload modal, commission modal, community/blog) which was blocked by this missing selector.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 919-line module; consider splitting into routers (auth/assets/payments/storage) once stable.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True — most browsers reject credentials with wildcard; works here only because allow_origin_regex='.*' echoes the Origin. Prefer explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS env.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
stats() loads all assets into memory to sum downloads — use $group aggregation for scalability.

checkout_subscription stores plan but does not enforce idempotency on re-grant via /checkout/status (only grants if status flips to paid first time — OK, but tx['plan'] referenced via tx['plan'] only works if kind==subscription path stored it; verified correct).
Storage upload path embeds user_id in object key — fine, but no max-size check; large files could OOM the worker. Add size limit.
JWT secret default is hardcoded fallback only via env — good. JWT_SECRET present in .env, no leak.

success_rate.frontend: ~60% (home + hero + categories + cards verified; search/detail/login/dashboards not fully verified due to missing nav-search testid blocking the scripted flow)

test_credentials: demo@indieforge.dev / Demo@2026 (works, verified). admin@indieforge.dev / Admin@2026 seeded.
seed_data_creation: Server auto-seeds admin, demo user, 4 sample creators, 12 sample assets with reviews on startup. Verified via /api/stats (assets=12, creators=5, users>=6).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_indieforge.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. After main agent adds data-testid='nav-search' to Navbar input, re-run full frontend Playwright scenario: nav search→/marketplace?search=mech, click first asset-card→detail viewer (viewer-wireframe, viewer-light-purple/teal/amber, tab-description/specs/reviews/changelog), login as demo, user dashboard tabs (tab-purchases/favorites/invoices/notifications), /pricing select-plan-pro should redirect to Stripe, /creator upload-open opens modal w/ upload-title, /commissions commission-open opens modal.
